{{Quote|Commander Orda--he's got the walkers hidden near his base. They'll ambush anyone who attacks. That's all I know--please release me!|Republic commando to [[Darth Gravus]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
This '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Republic Special Forces Division|commando]]''' served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|True Sith Empire]]. Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he served as one of [[Kom Orda]]'s guards until he was captured by [[Thana Vesh]] and forced to reveal intel to her and her master [[Darth Gravus]].
